rules.title: Berkeley Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not inquire about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decisions, including refusing to rent or terminate a tenancy, requiring disclosure, demanding higher deposits or rent, or refusing to add a family member based on criminal history.

coverage_conditions.summary: Rental housing providers in Berkeley, except owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where the owner resides, and other listed exemptions.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Exempt if an owner of record resides in one of the units (1-3 unit property) as primary residence.
coverage_conditions.other_conditions: Exempt: lifetime sex offenders; limited exemptions for public housing/Section 8 properties; units under rental agreements allowing owners to move back (BMC 13.76.130 A.9); units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.

rules.exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record resides as primary residence; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back per BMC 13.76.130 A.9; units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
rules.quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.

rules.title: Fair Chance written notice and opportunity to respond
rules.requirement: If a landlord takes any action against an applicant or tenant based on criminal history, the landlord must give the applicant or tenant written notice and an opportunity to respond.

coverage_conditions.summary: Same coverage as the Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance, net of its exemptions.
coverage_conditions.owner_conditions: Exempt if owner-occupied 1-3 unit property where an owner of record resides.

rules.exemptions: Same exemptions as the ordinance generally (lifetime sex offenders, limited public housing/Section 8, owner-occupied 1-3 units, owner move-back agreements, sublet/roommate changes).
rules.quoted_span: If a landlord takes any action against an applicant or tenant based on criminal history (such as refusing to offer a lease, refusing to add a family member, etc.), the landlord is required to provide the applicant/tenant with written notice and an opportunity to respond.
